_comment: MolGate Master Index — target registry for Module 1–4

COX2.notes: 5IKT 共晶配體之 CCD 為 TLF（氟比洛芬）；target_drug 為實際 docking 欲測之藥物（Ibuprofen）

COX2_CLX.notes: COX2 / Celecoxib 專用條目；供 runner index_key=COX2_CLX 使用。

NEURAMINIDASE.notes: Influenza neuraminidase / Oseltamivir (Tamiflu) entry for runner drug 2.

ABLABL.notes: BCR-ABL kinase / Imatinib entry for runner drug 3.

DHFR.notes: DHFR / Methotrexate entry for runner drug 4.

CYP51.notes: CYP51 / Fluconazole entry for runner drug 5.

PDE5.notes: PDE5 / Sildenafil entry for runner drug 6.

CA2.notes: Carbonic anhydrase II / Acetazolamide entry for runner drug 7.

EGFR.notes: EGFR kinase / Gefitinib entry for runner drug 8.

D2R_7DFP.notes: D2 / spiperone (SIP) — Nat Commun 2020; use SIP centroid for box

VKOR.notes: 人源 VKOR 與 warfarin 共晶（6WV3，Science 2021）；抑制劑於 PDB 之 CCD 為 SWF（S-warfarin）。4KP6 為 PDE4B（1S1/MG/ZN），勿混用。

FKBP12_TACROLIMUS.notes: FKBP12–FK506 複合體（1FKJ）；共晶配體 CCD 為 FK5（tacrolimus）。Direct anchor，適合大環／立體化學佔據基準。

DRD2_QUETIAPINE_PROXY.notes: 無 quetiapine 與主要 CNS 受體之直接共晶時採用之 proxy：DRD2 非典型抗精神病藥口袋（6CM4），共晶配體 CCD 8NU（非 quetiapine）。日後若有 direct cocrystal 應另建條目並停用／取代本 proxy。

EGFR_ERLOTINIB.notes: Direct EGFR-erlotinib cocrystal anchor. Low stereochemical complexity; suitable as a stable kinase benchmark.

PDE5_VARDENAFIL.notes: Direct PDE5-vardenafil cocrystal anchor. Good family-pair benchmark with sildenafil.

FXA_APIXABAN.notes: Direct Factor Xa-apixaban cocrystal anchor. Low stereochemical burden; suitable for anticoagulant benchmark expansion.

FXA_RIVAROXABAN.notes: Direct Factor Xa-rivaroxaban cocrystal anchor. Good paired benchmark with apixaban under the same target family.

HDAC2_VORINOSTAT.notes: Direct HDAC2-vorinostat (SAHA) cocrystal anchor. Good zinc-dependent HDAC benchmark with simple ligand-side handling.

ABL_NILOTINIB.notes: Direct ABL-nilotinib cocrystal anchor. Clean second-generation kinase benchmark for the ABL family.

ABL_BOSUTINIB.notes: Direct ABL-bosutinib cocrystal anchor. Recommended to keep ABL first for benchmark consistency before adding SRC as a separate entry.

DDR1_PONATINIB.notes: Direct DDR1-ponatinib cocrystal anchor. Recommended as the clearest direct anchor for ponatinib before expanding to ABL/SRC variants.

PDE4D_CILOMILAST.notes: Direct PDE4D-cilomilast cocrystal anchor. Good PDE4 family benchmark with clear pocket logic and low stereochemical burden.

PDE4D_ROFLUMILAST.notes: Direct PDE4D-roflumilast cocrystal anchor. Recommended as a clean paired benchmark with cilomilast in the PDE4 family.

DPP4_ALOGLIPTIN.notes: Direct DPP4-alogliptin cocrystal anchor. Production index should use SY1 for 2ONC because the pocket ligand was resolved and selected as SY1 chain A.

DPP4_LINAGLIPTIN.notes: Direct DPP4-linagliptin cocrystal anchor. Good paired DPP4 benchmark with alogliptin.

TUBULIN.notes: 1SA0 α/β-tubulin；結構含 GTP/MG（核苷酸位）。自設小分子 docking 用 auto_detect 定口袋；M3 Engine B Stage 15 需勾選 GTP/MG 保留或移除。

AMPK_METFORMIN_PROXY.notes: 無 metformin–AMPK 直接共晶時採用之 proxy：human AMPK（4CFE）ADaM 小分子活化劑口袋，共晶配體 CCD 992（非 metformin）。Metformin 主要經 lysosomal/Complex I 路徑調控 AMPK，本條目僅供結構化 docking 探索，勿當 direct benchmark。

SITAGLIPTIN_DPP4.notes: Direct DPP4-sitagliptin cocrystal anchor (1X70). Third DPP4 gliptin benchmark alongside alogliptin and linagliptin.

ATORVASTATIN_HMGCR_PROXY.notes: Direct HMG-CoA reductase–atorvastatin cocrystal (1HWK). Index key retains _PROXY suffix from early catalog naming; anchor is direct.

ASPIRIN_COX2.notes: COX-2 NSAID pocket via 5IKT flurbiprofen (TLF) template; dock aspirin into the same pocket as Ibuprofen (COX2 entry).

OMEPRAZOLE_CYP2C19.notes: Human CYP2C19 active site (4GQS). Co-crystal ligand 0XV is a benzofuran inhibitor, not omeprazole; omeprazole is a CYP2C19 substrate—use pocket template only.

AMLODIPINE_CACNA1C_PROXY.notes: Human Cav1.2 (CACNA1C) cryo-EM structure 8WE8 with amlodipine (6UB) in the DHP blocker site. Index key retains _PROXY from early catalog; anchor is direct.

LOSARTAN_AT1R_PROXY.notes: Human AT1R (4ZUD); co-crystal OLM is olmesartan, not losartan

PIOGLITAZONE_PPARgamma_PROXY.notes: PPARgamma TZD scaffold (2PRG/BRL), not pioglitazone co-crystal

LANSOPRAZOLE_CYP2C19.notes: Human CYP2C19 template; 0XV is inhibitor not lansoprazole

METOPROLOL_ADRB1_PROXY.notes: Beta-1 adrenergic receptor; WHJ is carmoterol surrogate

HYDROCHLOROTHIAZIDE_CA2_PROXY.notes: CA2 pocket template via acetazolamide; thiazide mechanism differs

NAPROXEN_COX2.notes: NSAID pocket via 5IKT/TLF template; naproxen is not co-crystal ligand

MELOXICAM_COX2_PROXY.notes: COX-2 pocket via diclofenac analog site (5IKR/ID8)

HYDROXYCHLOROQUINE_LYSO_PROXY.notes: Exploratory lysosomal/endosomal template; not direct HCQ co-crystal

MONTELUKAST_CYSLT1_PROXY.notes: CysLT receptor; KNT is pranlukast surrogate (6RZ4)

ALBUTEROL_ADRB2_PROXY.notes: Beta-2 receptor; Y00 is dobutamine surrogate (2Y00)

PREDNISONE_NR3C1_PROXY.notes: Glucocorticoid receptor; DEX is dexamethasone surrogate

ACETAMINOPHEN_COX2_PROXY.notes: COX pocket template via 5IKT/TLF; acetaminophen COX mechanism debated

GLIPIZIDE_KATP_PROXY.notes: KATP SUR1-Kir6.2; GBL is glibenclamide surrogate (3SYQ)

PRAVASTATIN_HMGCR_PROXY.notes: HMGCR statin pocket via simvastatin site (1HW9/SIM); pravastatin not co-crystal ligand

VALSARTAN_AT1R_PROXY.notes: Human AT1R (4ZUD); OLM is olmesartan surrogate, not valsartan

PROPRANOLOL_ADRB1_PROXY.notes: Beta-1 adrenergic receptor; WHJ is carmoterol surrogate (2Y02)

INDOMETHACIN_COX2_PROXY.notes: COX-2 pocket via diclofenac analog site (5IKR/ID8)

AMOXICILLIN_PBP_PROXY.notes: Penicillin-binding protein template; PG2 is penicillin G surrogate (1PWP)

LEVOFLOXACIN_GYRASE.notes: DNA gyrase fluoroquinolone pocket via ciprofloxacin (2XCT/CPF)

GLIMEPIRIDE_KATP_PROXY.notes: KATP SUR1-Kir6.2; GBL is glibenclamide surrogate (3SYQ)

GEMFIBROZIL_PPARalpha_PROXY.notes: PPARalpha fibrate pocket via fenofibric acid analog (1K74/544)

BISOPROLOL_ADRB1_PROXY.notes: Beta-1 adrenergic receptor; WHJ is carmoterol surrogate (2Y02)

NIFEDIPINE_CACNA1C.notes: Cav1.2 DHP blocker site via amlodipine template (8WE8/6UB); nifedipine not co-crystal ligand

VERAPAMIL_CACNA1C_PROXY.notes: Cav1.2 channel template; phenylalkylamine mechanism differs from DHP site

PANTOPRAZOLE_CYP2C19_PROXY.notes: Human CYP2C19 (4GQS); 0XV is inhibitor surrogate, not pantoprazole

SULINDAC_COX2_PROXY.notes: COX-2 pocket via diclofenac analog site (5IKR/ID8)

GABAPENTIN_CACNA2D_PROXY.notes: Alpha2delta subunit exploratory template (5E6I); binding site debated

CARBAMAZEPINE_NAV_PROXY.notes: Exploratory voltage-gated channel template; carbamazepine mechanism is Na+ channel

VALPROIC_ACID_HDAC_PROXY.notes: HDAC pocket template via vorinostat site (4LXZ/SHH); VPA also has GABAergic mechanism

CLOPIDOGREL_P2Y12_PROXY.notes: P2Y12 template via ticagrelor site (4PY0/TIC); clopidogrel is prodrug

AMIODARONE_KCNH2_PROXY.notes: hERG channel template (5VA2/AMI); amiodarone has multi-target CV effects

ESOMEPRAZOLE_CYP2C19_PROXY.notes: Human CYP2C19 (4GQS); 0XV is inhibitor surrogate, not esomeprazole

NATEGLINIDE_KATP_PROXY.notes: KATP pocket via repaglinide site (3VE0/REP); nateglinide not co-crystal ligand

DILTIAZEM_CACNA1C_PROXY.notes: Cav1.2 channel template; benzothiazepine mechanism differs from DHP site

FUROSEMIDE_SLC12A_PROXY.notes: Exploratory loop diuretic template via CA2 site (3HS4/AZM); mechanism is NKCC2

LEVOTHYROXINE_THRB_PROXY.notes: Thyroid hormone receptor template via T3 site (1NAV/T3)

FENTANYL_OPRM1_PROXY.notes: Mu-opioid receptor template via morphine site (8DZP/MOR)

PREGABALIN_CACNA2D_PROXY.notes: Alpha2delta subunit exploratory template (5E6I); paired with gabapentin entry

LAMOTRIGINE_SCN_PROXY.notes: Exploratory voltage-gated channel template; lamotrigine targets Na+ channels

MIDOSTAURIN_FLT3.notes: FLT3/PKC kinase pocket via staurosporine site (1RJB/STA); midostaurin is staurosporine analog

PRASUGREL_P2Y12_PROXY.notes: P2Y12 template via ticagrelor site (4PY0/TIC); prasugrel is prodrug

ENALAPRIL_ACE_PROXY.notes: ACE pocket via lisinopril site (1O86/LIS); enalapril is prodrug

RAMIPRIL_ACE_PROXY.notes: ACE pocket via lisinopril site (1O86/LIS); ramipril is prodrug

CANDESARTAN_AT1R.notes: Human AT1R (4ZUD); OLM olmesartan surrogate, not candesartan co-crystal

IRBESARTAN_AT1R_PROXY.notes: Human AT1R (4ZUD); OLM is olmesartan surrogate

ATENOLOL_ADRB1_PROXY.notes: Beta-1 adrenergic receptor; WHJ is carmoterol surrogate (2Y02)

FELODIPINE_CACNA1C_PROXY.notes: Cav1.2 DHP blocker site via amlodipine template (8WE8/6UB)

TRAMADOL_OPRM1_PROXY.notes: Mu-opioid receptor template via morphine site (8DZP/MOR)

OXYCODONE_OPRM1_PROXY.notes: Mu-opioid receptor template via morphine site (8DZP/MOR)

DULOXETINE_SERT_PROXY.notes: SERT template; 8PR is paroxetine surrogate (5I6X); also NET activity

LORAZEPAM_GABA_A_PROXY.notes: GABA-A benzodiazepine site via clonazepam template (1KTF/CLZ)

BENAZEPRIL_ACE_PROXY.notes: ACE pocket via lisinopril site (1O86/LIS); benazepril is prodrug

CHLORTHALIDONE_CA2_PROXY.notes: CA2 template via acetazolamide (3HS4/AZM); thiazide-like diuretic

AMILORIDE_ENAC_PROXY.notes: Exploratory ENaC blocker template; mechanism differs from CA2 site

DIAZOXIDE_KATP_PROXY.notes: KATP channel template via sulfonylurea site (3SYQ/GBL); diazoxide is channel opener

SEMAGLUTIDE_GLP1R.notes: GLP-1R-semaglutide cryo-EM (6X18/SEM); peptide SMILES is placeholder

EXENATIDE_GLP1R.notes: GLP-1R-exenatide cryo-EM (5VAI/EXN); peptide SMILES is placeholder

CODEINE_OPRM1_PROXY.notes: Mu-opioid receptor template via morphine site (8DZP/MOR)

RANITIDINE_HRH2_PROXY.notes: H2 receptor template via famotidine site (3RSG/FAM)

DULAGLUTIDE_GLP1R.notes: GLP-1R via semaglutide cryo-EM (6X18/SEM); peptide placeholder SMILES

TEMSIROLIMUS_MTOR_PROXY.notes: mTOR via everolimus site (4JT6/EVL); rapalog family

NITROGLYCERIN_NOS_PROXY.notes: Exploratory NO/sGC pathway template; nitrate vasodilator

LIRAGLUTIDE_GLP1R_PROXY.notes: GLP-1R via semaglutide cryo-EM (6X18/SEM); peptide placeholder

SULFASALAZINE_DHFR_PROXY.notes: DHFR pocket via trimethoprim (2W9G/TMP); also anti-inflammatory prodrug

MINOXIDIL_KATP_PROXY.notes: KATP channel opener; template via sulfonylurea site (3SYQ/GBL)

GANCICLOVIR_DNA_POL_PROXY.notes: Viral DNA polymerase via acyclovir site (2GV9/ACV)

TEZACAFTOR_CFTR_PROXY.notes: CFTR corrector template via ivacaftor site (6MSM/IVA)

GLUCAGON_GCGR.notes: Glucagon receptor cryo-EM (4L6R/GLU); peptide placeholder SMILES
